# Identity & access blocks

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-skill-references.ts from the block manifests. -->

The Identity & access blocks of this version of better-supabase, from the block manifests. Install one with `npx better-supabase add <block>`; the docs page of each block has the method signatures. Entity names are the defaults; an app can rename them under `blocks.<name>.names`.

## created-by

Sets created_by on insert and updated_by on every write from auth.uid(); an update keeps created_by and the impersonation stamp. Service writes keep the values they send.

- Title: Actor stamping
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/created-by
- Client: `better-supabase/blocks/created-by`
- Modes: `managed`

## grants

Writes the complete Data API privileges of the tables and functions in the `expose` config for anon, authenticated and service_role, or derives table grants from the policies. A project with default privileges turned off grants new tables to no Data API role.

- Title: Data API grants
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/grants
- Modes: `managed`

## mfa

mfa_satisfied() for restrictive policies: true when the caller has no verified factor, or verified one in this session (aal2).

- Title: MFA enforcement
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/mfa
- Client: `better-supabase/blocks/mfa`
- Modes: `managed`

## permissions

can(), tenant_ids_with() and is_platform(): one permission contract for policies and SQL modules, over a roles list, a role and permission catalog, an authorization provider or the app's own functions (blocks.permissions.model).

- Title: Access contract
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/permissions
- Client: `permissionsBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/permissions`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`
- Works with: `invitations`, `organizations`, `memberships`

## sessions

session_active() for restrictive policies: false once the caller's session was signed out or expired, or the user was banned or deleted, so revoked access tokens stop working before they expire. options.policies writes the policy on every table.

- Title: Session revocation
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/sessions
- Client: `sessionsBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/sessions`
- Modes: `managed`
- Works with: `permissions`, `memberships`

## sso

Verified email domains with auto-join and SSO enforcement, SAML providers per organization registered with Supabase Auth, and SCIM 2.0 users and groups that provision memberships and map groups to roles.

- Title: SSO and SCIM
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/sso
- Client: `ssoBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/sso`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`
- Works with: `organizations`, `data-lifecycle`
- Events (`SsoEvents`): `organization.member_added`, `organization.member_removed`, `organization.role_changed`, `scim_group.created`, `scim_group.deleted`, `scim_group.updated`, `scim_user.created`, `scim_user.deleted`, `scim_user.updated`, `sso_domain.created`, `sso_domain.deleted`, `sso_domain.updated`, `sso_domain.verified`, `sso_provider.registered`, `sso_provider.unregistered`

## subjects

The app-wide subject registry from config.recordTypes: subject_title, subject_url, subject_titles, can_subject, can_subject_for and record_summary for every registered type, my_work across the installed blocks, record teams (subject_members, add_subject_member, end_subject_member, list_subject_members, my_subjects) that grant subjects.<type>.team actions, read logging for types with subjects.<type>.auditReads (record_subject_read, subject_access_log), and Realtime presence on presence:<type>:<id> for readers of the subject.

- Title: Subjects
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/subjects
- Client: `subjectsBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/subjects`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `permissions`
- Works with: `teams`, `memberships`, `audit`, `relations`
- Events (`SubjectsEvents`): `subject_member.added`, `subject_member.ended`

## access-requests

Members ask for a role or for access to one record, for a set time if they like. The request goes through approvals; the final approval grants it, and the grant ends early on request or when it expires. Emergency access opens a record at once and waits for a review.

- Title: Access requests
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/access-requests
- Client: `accessRequestsBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/access-requests`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`, `approvals`
- Works with: `outbox`, `audit`, `subjects`, `notifications`, `approvals`
- Entities: `access_request`
- Tables: `access_requests`
- Permission keys: `access_requests.read`, `access_requests.create`, `access_requests.manage`, `access_requests.emergency`, `access_requests.review`
- Events (`AccessRequestsEvents`): `access_request.approved`, `access_request.ended`, `access_request.requested`
- Provides: `recordAccess`

## identities

Links an email address or a chat user to an app user or a contact. Rows come only from a one-time code the signed-in user issues and the service redeems, or from a confirmed address in auth.users.

- Title: Identities
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/identities
- Client: `identitiesBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/identities`
- Modes: `managed`
- Works with: `contacts`
